_readme: Copy this file to .spotify-prefs.json to customize your setup. All fields are optional.
_startup_song_note: Set to a Spotify track URI to play a specific song every time the server starts. null = disabled.

mood_overrides._note: Override keywords for any built-in mood. Useful if the defaults don't match your taste.

custom_moods._note: Add entirely new moods. 'keywords' are Spotify playlist search terms. 'triggers' are words Claude looks for in your session context to auto-activate this mood.
